dataset: NHANES 2013-2018 (H+I+J pooled, 3,000-row seeded cap) - label = haemoglobin < WHO cut-off (13.0 M / 12.0 F); multi-cycle pool (was 2017-18 only); no lab features used (app-aligned). LOW_FEATURE_MODEL.
known_limitations: App-aligned projection of a real public dataset (ml/data/README.md) — not a local clinical sample; revalidate on local data before clinical use
Columns the source dataset never collected: diet_quality, frequent_fatigue, pale_cold, lightheadedness, brittle_nails — the app still asks these but the model cannot use them (LOW_FEATURE_MODEL)
Screening and awareness tool only, not a diagnostic device
